14.23.title: Solar Radiation Electric and Magnetic Field Amplitudes
14.23.title_cn: 太阳辐射电场与磁场振幅计算
14.23.description: On a clear day, with the sun directly overhead, the received power density from sunlight is about 1300 W/m². If we make the simplifying assumption that this power is transmitted via a single-frequency plane wave, find the resulting amplitude of the incident electric and magnetic fields.
14.23.description_cn: 在晴朗的日子里，太阳直射时，接收到的太阳光功率密度约为 1300 W/m²。假设该功率是通过单频平面波传输的，求入射电场和磁场的振幅。

steps.title: Power Density and Electric Field Relation
steps.explanation: Time-average Poynting vector magnitude for a plane wave in free space
steps.explanation_cn: 自由空间中平面波的时间平均坡印廷矢量模值

steps.title: Magnetic Field Amplitude
steps.explanation: Relation between E and H in a plane wave
steps.explanation_cn: 平面波中电场与磁场的关系

14.23.note: This is a simplified model. Actual sunlight is broadband and not a single-frequency plane wave, but this calculation gives the equivalent field strengths if all power were concentrated at one frequency.
14.23.note_cn: 这是一个简化模型。实际太阳光是宽带的，并非单频平面波，但该计算给出了将所有功率集中在一个频率时的等效场强。
